children: is exploring a bid to take Swedish-listed security company Verisure
private, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The reported move comes less than a year after its stock market debut when it was listed by private equity group Hellman & Friedman at a valuation of 13.7 billion euros ($15.39 billion).
The company is now valued at 9.70 billion euros, according to LSEG data.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
